title: 3.16 How Do You Spell It?
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Ask How do you spell your name? and How do you spell it?, and spell a name or a known word letter by letter, saying double for a repeated letter.
vocabulary: How do you spell your name?
grammar_function: How do you spell your name? / How do you spell it? + letters; double + letter.
prerequisite: 3.15 The Alphabet; 3.1 What is your name?; 1.10 dog; 2.1 park; 2.2 street; 2.3 book; 2.7 red and green.
speaking_outcome: Ask How do you spell your name? and spell Ana, Luis and known words such as G, R, double E, N.
